nodes.title: Vapi public teardown (account-free): 63 graded claims (53 observed, 7 inferred, 3 vendor-claimed) from docs (307-page llms.txt, 105 pages as Markdown, OpenAPI 74 paths), the pricing page, 561 public dashboard JS files, one 25 s homepage demo call capture, SDKs, job posts, engineering blog, status RSS and Trustpilot/HN; sha256 manifest of 781 raw files. report.md was refused by the subagent harness; its text is in the lane structured output.

Vapi cannot terminate Indian numbers: its Plivo guide says TRAI requires SIP termination on an Indian server, "which Vapi does not currently support". Twilio allows outbound to India only from non-Indian numbers. So an Indian enterprise on Vapi has no 140xx/1600xx/declared CLI and no DLT or A2P path. Regions are US (us-west-2), EU (Premier only) and AUS; no India region.

Vapi all-in list price for an Indian outbound minute via Twilio: USD 0.131-0.179 = INR 12.5-17.0 at FX 95, of which INR 9.46 is hosting ($0.05) plus Twilio to an Indian mobile ($0.0496) before any AI. Vapi-side hosting margin is an estimated 90-98% (inference, not measured).
nodes.n: 5 price components (hosting, Deepgram, OpenAI, ElevenLabs calculator ranges; Twilio India-mobile rate)
nodes.method: computed from vapi.ai/pricing and twilio.com/en-us/voice/pricing/in read 2026-10-20 (code/pricing.py); list prices, not an invoice

nodes.title:
Vapi architecture (graded):
- Observed: web calls on Daily WebRTC (mediasoup SFU on Oracle OKE us-ashburn-1; Cloudflare and Twilio TURN); call orchestration websocket in AWS us-west-2; own SIP SBCs on AWS us-west-2 and eu-central-1; Express API behind Cloudflare.
- Vendor-claimed: own streaming pipeline (VAD state machine, predict-and-scrap endpointing, latency-routed Azure OpenAI pool), not Pipecat or LiveKit Agents; Neon with Aurora fallback, k8s multi-cluster, Temporal.

Vapi status page, 2026-04-20 to 2026-10-20: 33 incidents and 18 maintenances. Includes a full US outage on 2026-05-21 of ~4 h 07 min (two hard-dependency databases; per the RCA, "scheduled and campaign calls ... were not retried automatically"), ~2 h of US call failures on 2026-08-19, and 3 SIP incidents in October. This sits against a 99.99% uptime claim (blog 2025-08-12).

nodes.title:
Vapi v2 notes:
- No memory across calls (0 memory pages); personalisation is server-supplied variables at call time.
- The improvement loop is manual: monitors, issues, scorecards, evals, simulations, traffic splits without statistics, and a flag-gated Composer "Improve the assistant" kickoff. Composer "cannot deploy to production automatically".
- Unannounced alpha: Mission Control (sentiment cards, live listen, live call control).

nodes.rationale: Vapi ships the deepest developer surface: versioning, tools, logs with 638 ended reasons, evals, simulations, monitors, Composer and campaigns. It cannot place domestic Indian calls, and its list price for an Indian minute is INR 12.5-17. So it sets the parity bar but competes for Indian buyers only through a bridge. The five tasks are where its documented behaviour fails Indian operations.
nodes.reverse_if: Vapi ships Indian SIP termination or an India region; or campaigns gain recurring windows plus per-contact retries; or 3+ buyer interviews name Vapi (bridged through an Indian CPaaS) as their incumbent; or the account phase shows the CSV normaliser is corrected server-side and the Indian-PSTN p50 reply gap is <= 1.5 s.

nodes.title: REA analyze-web-bundle as the bundle-analysis step for a large SPA dashboard (Vapi).
nodes.tried: npx rea-agents@6.7.0 analyze-web-bundle on headless Chromium CDP (dashboard.vapi.ai/register, allowed origin dashboard.vapi.ai, --fetch-source-maps, 4 s observation), plus inspect-web-network-capture on the raw Playwright HARs.
nodes.broke: analyze-web-bundle ran >5 min at ~105% CPU and ~6 GB RSS and wrote nothing before the 300 s timeout (the bolna lane hit the same empty output). inspect-web-network-capture refused HARs over 32 MB (42 MB raw) until bodies were stripped, then returned only normalised records. inspect-web-page worked (58 scripts, 0 source maps). Route, flag and CSV findings came from our own string analysis of 561 public chunks.

nodes.title: Vapi (USD 72M raised; claims 1M developers) adds an India region or Indian SIP termination through a licensed partner, and gains Composer-built agents with 1600-series calling. That would remove our plumbing moat against the reference developer platform.
nodes.mitigation: Watch Vapi changelog, status regions and SIP docs weekly (radar watchlist). Make VP's Indian operator layer (A2P declaration, consent and suppression, recurring windows and retries, business-language outcomes) the product, not just domestic routing. Keep BYOT so a buyer's existing Indian carrier works from day one.

nodes.title:
Do Vapi's pre-registered account-phase predictions P01-P10 hold?
- Browser call within 10 min, but no Indian-handset call without a second vendor and an international CLI.
- The CSV normaliser mis-prefixes 10-digit numbers; no recurring window or retries.
- Indian-PSTN reply gap p50 of 2.4-3.4 s.
- Invoice at INR 12-18/min.
nodes.closes_when: A Vapi trial (sign-up via team email, spend cap, Twilio account) runs P01-P10. That needs timed screen recordings, the 50-row CSV outcome per row, a 3-day schedule attempt, the l4b battery on our Plivo number (>= 30 clean turns, stereo), and the Vapi plus Twilio invoice lines.
